tool.title: folio MCP server, as a container
tool.description: Build and run the folio MCP server as one image carrying Bun, TeX Live, Lean, lean-lsp-mcp and the generated Python set — the image `deploy/` serves behind the auth gateway. Run it with `docker run -i --rm paper-assistant --stdio`, or `--http` on port 8080.

selection.when: Deploying the MCP server, or running it where its toolchain (TeX, Lean, Bun) is not installed.
selection.limits: The build context still COPYs a content repository's Lean packages and hecke-engine (see `.github/workflows/build-lean-mcp.yml`), so it builds from a folio checkout, not from this platform alone.
selection.cost: A multi-GB image; the first build takes tens of minutes.

remedies.none: The image build installs its toolchain from apt, cli.github.com, bun.sh and astral.sh; with any refused the image does not build. Run the server from a checkout instead: `bun run cat start:stdio`.

$comment.comment:
The MCP server's image is part of THIS Tool (bean `ar1s`, phase 2):
`install.container` is its build line — a script key, whose declared
command `deps:python:check` reads to find the image whose Python set it
checks. Manual, not `container`,
on invoke: running it starts a SERVER, and a container invoke arm would
be projected as an MCP tool that launches the server it is served by.
